---
title: "Ecosystem Map"
date: 2026-08-17
---

JHEEM is a family of compartmental epidemiological models (HIV and STIs) built on a shared simulation engine, calibrated to real surveillance data per city/state, and published as interactive policy tools at [jheem.org](https://jheem.org). The ecosystem spans roughly a dozen repositories in three groups: the **modeling core** (R packages and analysis code), the **delivery platform** (containerized data-generation and web infrastructure), and **support packages**.

## The repositories

### Modeling core

| Repo | What it is |
|------|-----------|
| `jheem2` | The simulation engine R package (~64k lines R + ~10k lines C++ via Rcpp, R6-based). Model specification → compiled specification → ODE engine → simulations → likelihoods → calibration, plus the data-manager class, ontology mapping, interventions, and plotting. Working branch is `dev`. |
| `jheem_analyses` | Applications repo: ~18 model applications (EHE, SHIELD, Ryan White, CDC testing, …), the data-manager build pipelines (`data_processing/`, `input_managers/`), shared glue (`commoncode/`, `source_code.R`), and the **syphilis-manager CI workflows** (`.github/workflows/`). |
| `jheem2_interactive`, `jheem_interactive` | Earlier Shiny-based interactive apps, superseded by the portal. Historical. |

### Support packages

| Repo | What it is |
|------|-----------|
| `locations` | Location codes/geography (e.g., `C.12580` = Baltimore MSA). A snapshot is baked into jheem2 at build time as internal package data. |
| `distributions` | Probability distribution utilities used across modeling code. |
| `bayesian.simulations` | MCMC machinery (adaptive blockwise Metropolis). Runs calibrations, **checkpoints chains to per-version/per-location cache directories** (resumable; acceptance stats stored per chain/step). |

### Delivery platform

| Repo | What it is |
|------|-----------|
| `jheem-portal` | Next.js frontend, live at [jheem.org](https://jheem.org). Ryan White (city + state), CDC testing, aging projections, custom on-demand simulations. |
| `jheem-backend` | Orchestration hub: `models.json` (source of truth for application/runtime/product config) + reusable GitHub Actions workflows that run containers to extract data and deploy to S3/CloudFront. |
| `jheem-containers` | Canonical monorepo for container images: shared R base + per-model images. Build → test-by-digest → promote CI with smoke, golden-regression, and perturbation tests; base-image compatibility cascade; fail-closed promotion (release re-tags the tested digest, never rebuilds). |
| `jheem-base` | Shared R base image (R 4.4.2, renv.lock-pinned packages **including jheem2 at a fixed ref**). Model containers extend it. |
| `jheem-simulations` | Simulation data distributed as semver'd GitHub Releases (3–86 GB per release), with documented deprecations. Feeds the container workflows. |
| `jheem-ryan-white-*-container`, `jheem-cdc-testing-container`, `jheem-container-minimal` | Former per-model container repos, consolidated into `jheem-containers` (history preserved). Treat as legacy; `jheem-container-minimal` remains a useful minimal-workspace reference. |

**Where the repos live:** `jheem2` and this wiki are in the **CIPHER-Epi** GitHub org (`jheem2` was transferred there; clones pointed at the old location still redirect). The delivery-platform repos are under `ncsizemore`, with org migration an open item on the [roadmap](roadmap.qmd).

## How data flows

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    RAW["Raw data<br/>(NAS / data-raw releases)"] --> DM["Data managers<br/>(.rdata artifacts)<br/>built by syphilis CI or locally"]
    DM --> CAL["Calibration<br/>(bayesian.simulations MCMC,<br/>per-city cache dirs)"]
    CAL --> SIM["Simsets<br/>(.rdata per city/state)"]
    SIM --> REL["GitHub Releases<br/>(jheem-simulations)"]
    REL --> CONT["Containers<br/>(jheem-containers,<br/>extract + transform)"]
    CONT --> S3["S3 + CloudFront"]
    S3 --> PORTAL["jheem.org<br/>(jheem-portal)"]
```

1. **Raw data** comes from surveillance sources (CDC Atlas, BRFSS, census, …), historically on the NAS / Q: drive, now also snapshotted as immutable `data-raw-v*` GitHub Releases.
2. **Data managers** are serialized R6 objects (`surveillance.manager.rdata`, `census.manager.rdata`, `syphilis.manager.rdata`, …) built by scripts in `jheem_analyses/data_processing/`. The **syphilis manager builds via CI**: release-pinned inputs, regression-gated merge, promotion workflow. Other managers are still built locally and ride along as pre-built dependencies. Analyses load managers into well-known globals (`SURVEILLANCE.MANAGER`, …) via `source_code.R`.
3. **Calibration** runs MCMC per location against likelihoods defined in jheem2, producing calibrated parameter sets. Chains checkpoint to cache directories at a configurable frequency and are resumable.
4. **Simsets** (simulation sets) are generated from calibrated parameters and stored as `.rdata`, then published as versioned **GitHub Releases** in `jheem-simulations`.
5. **Containers** (orchestrated by `jheem-backend` workflows) download release data, run jheem2 code to extract/transform outcomes, and write JSON/plot data to **S3**, served via **CloudFront**.
6. **The portal** reads that data and serves the interactive explorers.

## How jheem2 is loaded by consumers

Two modes, toggled by `jheem_analyses/use_jheem2_package_setting.R`:

- **Package mode** (`USE.JHEEM2.PACKAGE = T`): `library(jheem2)` against an installed build. Used for analysis workflows; CI and containers always work this way (pinned to a git ref).
- **Source mode** (`F`, the committed default): `source()`s ~40 files in hand-maintained order (`jheem2/R/tests/source_jheem2_package.R`) and JIT-compiles the C++.

Sourcing a model specification currently *requires* source mode: spec files call jheem2 functions that aren't exported from the package NAMESPACE (details in the [Spec Framework Notes](spec-framework-notes.qmd)). The NAMESPACE export sweep on the [roadmap](roadmap.qmd) removes that constraint, after which package mode (plus `devtools::load_all()` during development) can become the single supported path.

## Gotchas worth knowing

- **Serialized R6 is fragile.** Data managers and simsets are serialized R6 objects; evolving a class can strand old `.rdata` files. The CI's version pinning contains this; a format-versioned representation is the long-term fix.
- **jheem2 has no automated test suite yet.** The container golden tests in `jheem-containers` are currently the strongest regression net for engine changes — engine-touching work should be validated against them until in-package tests exist.
- **Source-mode loading recompiles the C++ every session**, making the local toolchain (R version, clang, SDK) a hidden dependency of the computation — the same jheem2 source ran clean under R 4.4 and segfaulted under R 4.5 (latent UB, see [Spec Framework Notes](spec-framework-notes.qmd)). Package mode compiles once per install; the NAMESPACE export sweep on the [roadmap](roadmap.qmd) is what unblocks it as the default.
